{"parentUuid":"522d89d1-c647-40fb-b05d-3bb72cae8da7","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. {"parentUuid":"a3ba8f2d-6078-4f7e-8c66-368e4148d1a4","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- sync-pull: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- ccs:continue: Continue last CCS delegation session [AUTO ENHANCE]\n- ccs: Delegate task with intelligent profile selection [AUTO ENHANCE]\n- budget-check: /budget-check — Current Session Token Budget Status\n- devils-advocate: /devils-advocate — Adversarial Critique\n- drift-check: /drift-check — Run Drift Signals DR1-DR12\n- drill-me: /drill-me — Interactive Ubiquitous Language Extraction\n- grill-me: /grill-me — Relentless Plan/Design Interview\n- handoff-read: /handoff-read — Lightweight Last Session Load\n- master-plan: /master-plan — High-Level Work Decomposition\n- session-end: /session-end — Close Work Session\n- session-start: /session-start — Begin Work Session\n- session-verify: /session-verify — Mid-Session Alignment Check\n- spec-author: /spec-author — Create Dual-Layer Specification\n- spec-to-wiki: /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format\n- ul-audit: /ul-audit — Audit Ubiquitous Language Consistency\n- vbw-check: /vbw-check — Apply Verify-Before-Write Protocol\n- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation\n- review: Review a pull request\n- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch","skillCount":49,"isInitial":true},"type":"attachment","uuid":"ed8224fa-57b5-418a-adb5-05d0d4fad7f9","timestamp":"2026-04-29T17:06:10.424Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"302fc447-cdb8-4e0e-bae6-af6f07ebadcd","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"a214082c-f8a1-447f-bc9d-c892da0e5cc6","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"45b2825c-e69f-425d-960f-05764cfd0a3f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NvWxq7kQJVoCCWAX2WVfLc","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# PROJECT CHARTER\n2\t## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n3\t\n4\t> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n5\t> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n6\t> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n7\t\n8\t---\n9\t\n10\t## Vision\n11\t\n12\tAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n13\t\n14\tPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n15\t\n16\tPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. After 12-24 months of dogfood, the system should be a genuine advisor I would pay money for if someone else built it.\n17\t\n18\tNot a goal: high-frequency trading, replacing human judgment, becoming a SaaS in Year 1, beating frontier LLMs at general reasoning, providing licensed financial advice.\n19\t\n20\t---\n21\t\n22\t## The Core Insight (the why)\n23\t\n24\t**Quant funds (Renaissance, Two Sigma, DE Shaw) win in efficient markets through clean data + execution speed + diverse alpha factors.** They don't use sentiment from Facebook/YouTube because at their scale it's noise, not signal — and in efficient markets it gets arbitraged away anyway.\n25\t\n26\t**Vietnam stock market inverts this.** It is structurally inefficient:\n27\t- 85-90% retail investor share (vs 20-25% in US)\n28\t- Information asymmetry between sophisticated and retail crowd\n29\t- KOL/influencer recommendations measurably move prices\n30\t- \"Đội lái\" (pump operators) operate openly\n31\t- News and narrative cycles dominate over fundamentals for months at a time\n32\t- Foreign flow creates non-fundamental price pressure\n33\t\n34\tIn this market, **sentiment + influence + narrative tracking is signal, not noise**. And LLMs can process Vietnamese unstructured text at scale that was impossible before 2023.\n35\t\n36\tThis creates a **structural arbitrage**: apply quant methodology + LLM reasoning + sentiment/influence data layers that no commercial product offers for VN. Position not as \"decision maker\" but as **advisor + alert watcher + bias mirror**.\n37\t\n38\t---\n39\t\n40\t## The Craft Philosophy\n41\t\n42\tTake the craft seriously. Build for personal use first, commercial second.\n43\t\n44\t- Production-grade engineering standards from Day 1 (DDD + clean architecture + multi-loop discipline)\n45\t- Commercial extension kept as option, never as driver\n46\t- When self-use conflicts with hypothetical-future-SaaS, self-use wins\n47\t- Quality bar: I genuinely trust output enough to act on real money decisions\n48\t- Edge comes from compounding moats (proprietary data, calibration, personal bias log), not from any single feature\n49\t\n50\tReference models: Renaissance Technologies (data + iteration discipline), Bridgewater (principles-based decision making), personal Bloomberg Terminal (data density + analysis depth), Athletic.com (subscription-quality content for niche audience).\n51\t\n52\t---\n53\t\n54\t## Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n55\t\n56\t1. **Evidence grounding** — every claim, every number traceable to source + as-of date. Hallucination in finance = bug, not stylistic issue.\n57\t\n58\t2. **Structured output over narrative** — multi-criteria assessment, never single \"buy/sell\" score. Output is trade-off matrix.\n59\t\n60\t3. **Adversarial by design** — bear + bull + critic + quant + behavior + manager perspectives. Never consensus from single agent.\n61\t\n62\t4. **Proprietary data moat** — every news ingested, every KOL recommendation tracked, every thesis post-mortem'd compounds the edge. Raw data is sacred.\n63\t\n64\t5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n65\t\n66\t6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n67\t\n68\t7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n69\t\n70\t8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n71\t\n72\t9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n73\t\n74\t10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n75\t\n76\t---\n77\t\n78\t## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n79\t\n80\tSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n81\t\n82\t**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n83\t\n84\t**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n85\t\n86\t**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n87\t\n88\t**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n89\t\n90\tThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n91\t\n92\tSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n93\t\n94\t---\n95\t\n96\t## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n97\t\n98\t**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n99\t- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n100\t- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n101\t- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n102\t- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n103\t\n104\tOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n105\t\n106\t---\n107\t\n108\t## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n109\t\n110\t- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n111\t- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n112\t- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n113\t- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n114\t- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n115\t- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n116\t\n117\t---\n118\t\n119\t## Success Criteria\n120\t\n121\t**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n122\t- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n123\t- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n124\t- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n125\t- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n134\t- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n135\t- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n136\t- Personal bias log (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n153\t- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n154\t- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n155\t- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n156\t- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n157\t- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n158\t- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n159\t- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n160\t- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n161\t\n162\t**Architecture:**\n163\t- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n164\t- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n165\t- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n166\t- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n167\t\n168\t**Development approach:**\n169\t- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n170\t- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n171\t- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n172\t- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n173\t- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n174\t\n175\t---\n176\t\n177\t## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n178\t\n179\t**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n180\t- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n181\t- Vietstock public — financial reports\n182\t- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n183\t- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n184\t- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n185\t- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n186\t\n187\t**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n188\t- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n189\t- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n190\t- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n191\t\n192\t**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n193\t\n194\t---\n195\t\n196\t## Meta-Discipline\n197\t\n198\tThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n199\t\n200\t- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n\nThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n\nSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n\n---\n\n## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n\n**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n\nOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n\n---\n\n## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n\n- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n\n---\n\n## Success Criteria\n\n**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n\n**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n\n**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n\n**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n\n**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n\n---\n\n## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n\n**Stack:**\n- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n\n**Architecture:**\n- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n\n**Development approach:**\n- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n\n---\n\n## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n\n**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n- Vietstock public — financial reports\n- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n\n**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n\n**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n\n---\n\n## Meta-Discipline\n\nThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n\n- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n\n---\n\n## Revision Protocol\n\nThis charter changes only when:\n- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, regulatory change, etc.)\n\nCharter revisions require:\n- Written rationale with evidence (linked to specific sessions/post-mortems)\n- 48-hour cool-down before committing change\n- Explicit version bump (v1.0 → v2.0)\n\nMinor clarifications go in `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`. This charter stays stable.\n\n---\n\n## Document Index\n\n| Document | Purpose | Stability |\n|---|---|---|\n| `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` (this) | Vision + principles | Immutable for ~3 months |\n| `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` | Agent configs, skills, workflows | Living, frequent updates |\n| `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | How to write specs | Stable |\n| `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` | Strategic: signal architecture | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md` | First implementation spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md` | KOL tracking system spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md` | Pump detection spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/004-multi-perspective-adversarial-agents.md` | Adversarial analysis spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md` | Pipeline self-optimization spec | Stable |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` | Current state | Continuously updated |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules | Append-mostly |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` | All thesis ever recorded | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/` | Thesis outcome reviews | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/calibration/` | KOL accuracy, signal calibration data | Continuously updated |\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Charter (what we explicitly reject)\n\nTo stay focused, we reject these tempting paths:\n\n- **Predict prices with ML models** — models trained on VN price data overfit; no edge there.\n- **Compete with broker research** — we have less data, less staff. We win on integration + edge sources, not on raw analysis depth.\n- **Build for general retail public** — we build for ourselves and 3-5 peers. Mass market needs hand-holding we won't provide.\n- **Trust LLM for numbers** — every numerical output must come from code with traceable inputs.\n- **Build features without dogfooding** — speculative features die fast in this project.\n- **Optimize for backtest performance** — Goodhart's Law is real. We optimize for forward decision quality.\n- **Make money fast** — this is a 24-month project minimum to reach edge. Quick wins are anti-pattern.\n","numLines":257,"startLine":1,"totalLines":257}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a214082c-f8a1-447f-bc9d-c892da0e5cc6","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"302fc447-cdb8-4e0e-bae6-af6f07ebadcd","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"484a25d8-514a-403b-92ad-abffef1ed88a","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"nested_memory","path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","content":{"path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","type":"Project","content":"# agent-workspace/ — Contract\n\n> **Audience**: agents working inside `agent-workspace/`.\n> **Established**: Decision 002 § Track 1 (Workspace Dualism Foundation).\n\n## Identity\n\n`agent-workspace/` is the **agent-owned execution + memory** layer. Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\n\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\n\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Highest-priority for this directory:)\n\n- **AP-1 Same-agent self-review** — never review your own implementation; dispatch fresh-context verifier\n- **AP-2 Self-track wind-down** — `.transcript-tokens` real-transcript is authoritative, not LLM self-track\n- **AP-5 Charter-coherence defer overriding user-CRITICAL** — re-read all `user_prompt/*` at every phase entry; never silently defer USER-CRITICAL\n- **AP-7 Performative SC ticking** — defer with explicit prerequisites > fire vacuous proposals\n- **AP-8 Pre-staged work causing checkpoint drift** — update `current-execution.md` immediately on task complete, not session-end\n- **AP-17 Identity drift** — stockforge is AI-first VN stock advisory; not generic financial framework (see `constitution/identity-scope.md` once Track 7 ships)\n- **AP-23 Continuous LLM-Guardian** — deterministic hooks = Guardian; LLM Guardian only at session-end aggregation\n\n---\n\n## Connection to human-workspace/\n\nThis directory is the agent's domain. Human's domain is `human-workspace/`. The two communicate through:\n- Human → Agent: `human-workspace/user_prompt/`, `human-workspace/decisions/`\n- Agent → Human: `human-workspace/notifications/`, `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`\n- Bidirectional: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/` (agent writes pending; human moves answered)\n- Audit trail: this directory's `memory/decisions/` references `human-workspace/` source files via path pointers\n\nAgent never writes to `human-workspace/` outside the designated `q-and-a/pending/` channel.\n","contentDiffersFromDisk":false},"displayPath":"agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"67cf19a8-0e6a-41ce-9692-ee3160db6169","timestamp":"2026-04-29T17:06:22.545Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"302fc447-cdb8-4e0e-bae6-af6f07ebadcd","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Per `agent-workspace/CLAUDE.md` rule 1, agents WRITE to `proposals/`; user approve appends this delta to `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`.\n\n## Append to `architecture.md` (NEW section, after Forbidden Patterns)\n\n---\n\n## Slash Command vs Skill — Responsibility Split\n\nSlash commands (`.claude/commands/<name>.md`) and skills (`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) overlap in form (both are markdown procedure files) but should NOT overlap in responsibility. Per L-S14-2 (skill-vs-command duplication multiplier), duplicating procedure between a `/foo` command and a `foo` skill multiplies maintenance cost AND creates drift between the two when one updates and the other doesn't.\n\n### Responsibility Split\n\n| Concern | Slash Command | Skill |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Trigger** | User explicit invocation: `/<name>` | Auto-discovered by Claude Code via `description:` keyword match |\n| **Audience** | User-facing workflow (command sequence to execute) | Agent-facing procedure (rules to follow when context matches) |\n| **Body shape** | \"When user types `/<name>`, do these N steps\" — imperative checklist | \"When working in context X, follow this discipline\" — declarative rules |\n| **Reusability** | Single workflow tied to a slash invocation | Reusable across many tasks that match the description |\n| **LOC ceiling** | 120 (per drift-signals D1) | 150 (per drift-signals D1) |\n\n### Anti-Pattern: Duplicated Body\n\nIf `/<name>` command and `<name>` skill both exist with overlapping body content, the skill MUST be the source of truth and the command body MUST delegate (e.g., the command body says \"invokes `<name>` skill via Skill tool\" or copy-references the skill's authoritative rules).\n\n**Example (correct)**: `/grill-me` command body is short — describes user-facing trigger; the procedure lives in `grill-maximization` skill, which the command references.\n\n**Example (anti-pattern)**: `/grill-me` command body and `grill-maximization` skill both contain a 80-line \"how to bundle questions\" procedure. When the bundling rule changes (e.g., 4-question max per AskUserQuestion limit), only one gets updated. The drift signal D-DUPL (TBD) flags >50% line overlap between command + skill of similar name.\n\n### Boundary Heuristics\n\n- If the procedure runs once per user invocation → slash command\n- If the procedure runs across many tasks based on context auto-match → skill\n- If both apply: skill carries the body; command is the entry point\n\n## End of amendment\n","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":50}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"61e171e2-b531-431e-a2d3-8b08747726ad","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"302fc447-cdb8-4e0e-bae6-af6f07ebadcd","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ec20ced5-4ef9-4450-8245-f816debcec45","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"45b2825c-e69f-425d-960f-05764cfd0a3f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Pwxteamqkr9KC3VwPwFiEJ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# write-a-skill — Best Practices (S16 amendment)\n2\t\n3\t> Companion to `SKILL.md`. Lessons from S14 progressive-disclosure refactor of top-8 D1 violators.\n4\t\n5\t## L-S14-1 — First-draft compression reserve\n6\t\n7\tWhen refactoring an existing skill that violates D1 (LOC ceiling 150 for skills, 120 for commands, 200 for agents), aim for a first-draft target **20% under** the ceiling, not at the ceiling. Reason: subsequent additions (best practices learned during use, cross-references to new sibling skills, examples) accumulate. A skill that lands AT 150 will violate D1 within 2-3 amendments.\n8\t\n9\t**Concrete target**: skill SKILL.md first-draft = 110-130 LOC; budget 20-40 LOC reserve for amendments. Move depth to `references/<topic>.md` early; keep SKILL.md as the orientation surface.\n10\t\n11\t**Anti-example**: a skill drafted at 148 LOC \"to fit\" the 150 ceiling. Within one amendment cycle it lands at 165 = D1 violation. Refactor cost = re-split into references/. Net cost > if drafted at 120 with planned references/ companions.\n12\t\n13\t**Correct example**: `try-n-approaches/SKILL.md` first draft = 120 LOC; budget for amendments = 30 LOC; references for `output-template.md` + `metric-patterns.md` carry depth.\n14\t\n15\t## L-S14-2 — Skill vs Command — Responsibility Split\n16\t\n17\tSkills (`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) and slash commands (`.claude/commands/<name>.md`) overlap in form (both markdown procedures) but should NOT overlap in body content. Per `proposals/architecture-amendment.md` § Slash Command vs Skill:\n18\t\n19\t- Skill = agent-facing procedure auto-discovered by description match\n20\t- Command = user-facing trigger; body delegates to skill where possible\n21\t\n22\t**Anti-pattern**: writing a `<name>` skill and `/<name>` command with overlapping 80-line bodies. When the rule changes (e.g., AskUserQuestion 4-question max), only one gets updated. The duplication multiplier doubles maintenance cost; drift is inevitable.\n23\t\n24\t**Correct example**: `/grill-me` command body = short user-facing trigger; the procedure body lives in `grill-maximization` skill, which the command references via Skill tool invocation.\n25\t\n26\t**When in doubt**: if the procedure is \"what to do when context X auto-matches\" → skill. If it's \"what to do when user types `/<name>`\" → command. If both apply: skill carries body; command is entry point.\n27\t\n28\t## L-S14-1 corollary — references/ as expansion buffer\n29\t\n30\tWhen a skill's content grows past first-draft compression reserve, the right move is to extract topical sub-sections to `references/<topic>.md` (no D1 ceiling on references/) and replace inline content with a one-line pointer. Don't compress at the cost of clarity.\n31\t\n32\t**Example structure**:\n33\t```\n34\t.claude/skills/<name>/\n35\t├── SKILL.md                # ≤150 LOC; orientation + when-to-use + core rules\n36\t├── references/\n37\t│   ├── best-practices.md   # Lessons learned (this file pattern)\n38\t│   ├── output-template.md  # Detailed output schema\n39\t│   └── examples.md         # Concrete examples\n40\t```\n41\t\n42\tAgent loads SKILL.md first; references/ on-demand only.\n43\t"}]},"uuid":"9d593616-dc17-40f2-bc12-e512f14533b5","timestamp":"2026-04-29T17:07:10.358Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\skills\\write-a-skill\\references\\best-practices.md","content":"# write-a-skill — Best Practices (S16 amendment)\n\n> Companion to `SKILL.md`. Lessons from S14 progressive-disclosure refactor of top-8 D1 violators.\n\n## L-S14-1 — First-draft compression reserve\n\nWhen refactoring an existing skill that violates D1 (LOC ceiling 150 for skills, 120 for commands, 200 for agents), aim for a first-draft target **20% under** the ceiling, not at the ceiling. Reason: subsequent additions (best practices learned during use, cross-references to new sibling skills, examples) accumulate. A skill that lands AT 150 will violate D1 within 2-3 amendments.\n\n**Concrete target**: skill SKILL.md first-draft = 110-130 LOC; budget 20-40 LOC reserve for amendments. Read Raw Spec Completely\n\nParse:\n- Frontmatter (spec_id, tier, status)\n- Part A, B, C structure\n- All mentioned terms and entities\n\n### 2. Identify Linkable Items\n\nScan for:\n\n**Glossary terms** (from `agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md`):\n- Every mention becomes `[[term-name]]`\n- Create stub if page doesn't exist\n\n**Spec cross-references**:\n- `SPEC-2026-04-001` → `[[SPEC-2026-04-001]]`\n\n**Bounded contexts**:\n- \"BC-6 Influence Network\" → `[[bc/influence]]`\n\n**Entity mentions**:\n- Company names, tickers, KOLs\n- Create stub pages in `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/`\n\n### 3. Generate Wiki File\n\nTarget: `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier<N>-<type>/<spec_id>-<slug>.md`\n\nStructure:\n\n```markdown\n---\ntype: spec\ntier: 2\nspec_id: SPEC-2026-04-001\nspec_slug: validate-investment-thesis\nstatus: draft\nversion: 1.0\ncreated: 2026-04-20\nlast_reviewed: 2026-04-20\nbounded_contexts:\n  - \"[[bc/analysis]]\"\n  - \"[[bc/portfolio]]\"\nrelated_specs: []\nubiquitous_language_terms:\n  - \"[[Thesis]]\"\n  - \"[[BearAnalysis]]\"\n  - \"[[Catalyst]]\"\nsource_raw: \"[../../../specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md]\"\ntags:\n  - spec\n  - tier2\n  - feature\n  - analysis\n---\n\n# [[SPEC-2026-04-001]] — Validate Investment Thesis\n\n> Wiki view of [[SPEC-2026-04-001]]. \n> Raw source: [../../../specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md](../../../specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md)\n\n## Navigation\n\n- [[#Part A — Business Specification]]\n- [[#Part B — Agent Contract]]\n- [[#Part C — Provenance & Review]]\n\n## Related Nodes\n\n- **Depends on**: [[bc/market-data]]\n- **Enables**: [[bc/portfolio]]\n- **Bounded contexts**: [[bc/analysis]], [[bc/portfolio]]\n- **Key terms**: [[Thesis]], [[BearAnalysis]], [[BullAnalysis]], [[Catalyst]]\n\n---\n\n[Full content of raw spec, with wikilinks applied]\n```\n\n### 4. Wikilink Application Rules\n\n**First mention of term in wiki doc**: add wikilink\n```markdown\nA [[Thesis]] is the structured investment analysis produced...\n```\n\n**Subsequent mentions in same doc**: plain text OK (avoid link spam)\n```markdown\nWhen thesis is submitted, the system emits ThesisSubmittedEvent...\n```\n\n**Code references**: don't wikilink inside code blocks\n```python\n# This is plain code — no wikilinks\nthesis = Thesis.create(ticker, bull, bear)\n```\n\n### 5. Create Missing Stubs\n\nFor mentioned entities/concepts without wiki page:\n\nStub at `obsidian-vault/wiki/entities/<slug>.md`:\n\n```markdown\n---\ntype: entity\nstatus: stub\nsource_mentions:\n  - \"[[SPEC-2026-04-001]]\"\ncreated: 2026-04-20\ntags:\n  - stub\n  - entity\n---\n\n# [[Entity Name]]\n\n> Stub page. Created because mentioned in [[SPEC-2026-04-001]]. \n> Please expand with context and connections.\n\n## Context\nFirst mentioned in context of: [brief description from where]\n\n## Properties\n- [Add structured info as known]\n\n## Relationships\n- Connected to: [list]\n\n## Backlinks\n*(Obsidian auto-populates)*\n```\n\n### 6. Update Index\n\nRead `obsidian-vault/wiki/_index.md`, append new entry:\n\n```markdown\n## Specs\n\n### Tier 2 (Feature)\n\n- [[specs/tier2-feature/SPEC-2026-04-001-validate-investment-thesis]]\n  - Status: draft\n  - BCs: [[bc/analysis]], [[bc/portfolio]]\n  - Created: 2026-04-20\n```\n\n### 7. Append to Log\n\n`obsidian-vault/wiki/_log.md`:\n\n```markdown\n## [2026-04-20] ingest | SPEC-2026-04-001\n\n**Type**: spec (tier 2)\n**Title**: Validate Investment Thesis\n**Raw source**: `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md`\n**Wiki entry**: `obsidian-vault/wiki/specs/tier2-feature/SPEC-2026-04-001-validate-investment-thesis.md`\n**Stubs created**:\n- `wiki/entities/vcb.md`\n- `wiki/concepts/adversarial-analysis.md`\n**Existing links to**: [[Thesis]], [[BearAnalysis]], [[BullAnalysis]] (x6)\n```\n\n## Regeneration (Updating Existing Wiki)\n\nWhen raw spec changes and wiki already exists:\n\n### Diff-Based Update\n\n1. Regenerate from raw\n4. Preserve human additions\n5. Update \"last_reviewed\" in frontmatter\n\n### Full Regeneration\n\nIf spec changes fundamentally:\n1. Move old wiki to `obsidian-vault/wiki/archive/<date>/`\n2. Generate fresh\n3. All failed — log and return None\n67\t    logger.warning('All price selectors failed', url=page.url)\n68\t    return None\n69\t```\n70\t\n71\t## VBW for Scrapers\n72\t\n73\t**Before** writing scraper selector:\n74\t1. Write selector based on ACTUAL DOM, not assumed structure\n79\t\n80\tThis is VBW Protocol applied to scrapers. Critical.\n81\t\n82\t## Retry & Backoff (tenacity)\n83\t\n84\t```python\n85\tfrom tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential, retry_if_exception_type\n86\timport httpx\n87\t\n88\t@retry(\n89\t    stop=stop_after_attempt(5),\n90\t    wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=30),\n91\t    retry=retry_if_exception_type((httpx.HTTPError, httpx.TimeoutException)),\n92\t)\n93\tasync def fetch_with_retry(url: str) -> str:\n94\t    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:\n95\t        response = await client.get(url, timeout=30)\n96\t        \n97\t        if response.status_code == 429:\n98\t            raise httpx.HTTPStatusError(\"Rate limited\", request=response.request, response=response)\n99\t        \n100\t        response.raise_for_status()\n101\t        return response.text\n102\t```\n103\t\n104\t## Rate Limiting\n105\t\n106\tRespect the site. Use token bucket per domain:\n107\t\n108\t```python\n109\timport asyncio\n110\tfrom collections import defaultdict\n111\t\n112\tclass RateLimiter:\n113\t    def __init__(self, calls_per_minute: int = 10):\n114\t        self._semaphores: dict[str, asyncio.Semaphore] = defaultdict(\n115\t            lambda: asyncio.Semaphore(calls_per_minute)\n116\t        )\n117\t    \n118\t    async def acquire(self, domain: str) -> None:\n119\t        async with self._semaphores[domain]:\n120\t            await asyncio.sleep(60 / 10)  # simple approach\n121\t\n122\trate_limiter = RateLimiter(calls_per_minute=10)\n123\t\n124\tasync def polite_fetch(url: str) -> str:\n125\t    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n126\t    domain = urlparse(url).netloc\n127\t    await rate_limiter.acquire(domain)\n128\t    return await fetch_with_retry(url)\n129\t```\n130\t\n131\t## Monitoring for Silent Break\n132\t\n133\tEvery crawler should emit shape metrics:\n134\t\n135\t```python\n136\tasync def crawl_news_listing(query: str) -> list[dict]:\n137\t    articles = await extract_articles(page)\n138\t    \n139\t    # Emit shape metrics\n140\t    logger.info(\"Crawl shape\", \n141\t        query=query,\n142\t        article_count=len(articles),\n143\t        with_title=sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"title\")),\n144\t        with_url=sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"url\")),\n145\t        with_published_at=sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"published_at\")),\n146\t    )\n147\t    \n148\t    # Alert if anomalous\n149\t    if len(articles) == 0:\n150\t        logger.error(\"Crawler returned zero articles\", query=query)\n151\t    \n152\t    if sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"url\")) / max(len(articles), 1) < 0.5:\n153\t        logger.warning(\"URL extraction rate dropped below 50%\", query=query)\n154\t    \n155\t    return articles\n156\t```\n157\t\n158\t## Caching Pattern\n159\t\n160\t```python\n161\timport hashlib\n162\timport redis.asyncio as redis\n163\t\n164\tasync def fetch_cached(url: str, ttl_sec: int = 3600) -> str:\n165\t    key = f\"crawl:{hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest()}\"\n166\t    \n167\t    cached = await redis_client.get(key)\n168\t    if cached:\n169\t        logger.debug(\"Cache hit\", url=url)\n170\t        return cached.decode()\n171\t    \n172\t    content = await polite_fetch(url)\n173\t    await redis_client.setex(key, ttl_sec, content)\n174\t    return content\n175\t```\n176\t\n177\tTTL guidance:\n178\t- News listings: 1-6 hours\n179\t- Article detail: 24-72 hours\n180\t- Static content (about pages): 7 days\n181\t- Market data: don't cache or very short TTL (5-15 min)\n182\t\n183\t## Storage\n184\t\n185\tRaw crawled pages → Cloudflare R2:\n186\t```python\n187\timport boto3\n188\t\n189\ts3 = boto3.client(\"s3\", endpoint_url=R2_ENDPOINT)\n190\t\n191\ts3.put_object(\n192\t    Bucket=\"stockforge-raw\",\n193\t    Key=f\"raw-crawl/{domain}/{date}/{url_hash}.html\",\n194\t    Body=content.encode(),\n195\t    Metadata={\n196\t        \"url\": url,\n197\t        \"fetched_at\": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),\n198\t        \"status_code\": str(response.status_code),\n199\t    },\n200\t)\n201\t```\n202\t\n203\tParsed structure → Postgres. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n---\n\n# Skill: Crawler Reliability\n\n## Purpose\n\nWeb scrapers have silent-break failure mode. Selector looks right, passes tests, breaks in production when site updates. This skill minimizes that risk.\n\n## Core Principles\n\n1. **Verify selector against live DOM before committing**\n2. **Retry with backoff, but with budget cap**\n3. **Monitor for silent break (output shape changes)**\n4. **Respect rate limits and robots.txt**\n5. **Cache aggressively — fetch once, parse many**\n\n## Stack\n\n- **Playwright** (headless Chromium) for dynamic sites\n- **httpx** or **aiohttp** for static APIs\n- **tenacity** for retry logic\n- **Redis** for caching fetched pages\n- **yt-dlp** for YouTube transcripts\n- **Cloudflare R2** for raw content storage\n\n## Selector Robustness\n\n### Bad (fragile)\n```python\nprice = await page.text_content('.product-card > div:nth-child(2) > span.price')\n# Breaks when site reshuffles DOM\n```\n\n### Good (robust)\n```python\n# Prefer stable attributes\nprice = await page.text_content('[data-testid=\"stock-price\"]')\n\n# Or aria-label\nprice = await page.text_content('[aria-label=\"Stock price\"]')\n\n# Or nearby text + relationship\nprice_el = await page.locator('text=\"Giá:\"').locator('+ span').text_content()\n```\n\n### Fallback chain\n```python\nasync def extract_price(page) -> str | None:\n    strategies = [\n        lambda: page.text_content('[data-testid=\"price\"]'),\n        lambda: page.text_content('[itemprop=\"price\"]'),\n        lambda: page.locator('text=/[\\\\d,]+đ/').first().text_content(),\n    ]\n    \n    for strategy in strategies:\n        try:\n            result = await strategy()\n            if result:\n                return result\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    \n    # All failed — log and return None\n    logger.warning('All price selectors failed', url=page.url)\n    return None\n```\n\n## VBW for Scrapers\n\n**Before** writing scraper selector:\n1. Fetch live HTML: `curl URL > sample.html`\n2. Open in browser\n3. Inspect actual DOM\n4. Identify stable selectors\n5. Write selector based on ACTUAL DOM, not assumed structure\n\nThis is VBW Protocol applied to scrapers. Critical.\n\n## Retry & Backoff (tenacity)\n\n```python\nfrom tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential, retry_if_exception_type\nimport httpx\n\n@retry(\n    stop=stop_after_attempt(5),\n    wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=1, max=30),\n    retry=retry_if_exception_type((httpx.HTTPError, httpx.TimeoutException)),\n)\nasync def fetch_with_retry(url: str) -> str:\n    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:\n        response = await client.get(url, timeout=30)\n        \n        if response.status_code == 429:\n            raise httpx.HTTPStatusError(\"Rate limited\", request=response.request, response=response)\n        \n        response.raise_for_status()\n        return response.text\n```\n\n## Rate Limiting\n\nRespect the site. Use token bucket per domain:\n\n```python\nimport asyncio\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nclass RateLimiter:\n    def __init__(self, calls_per_minute: int = 10):\n        self._semaphores: dict[str, asyncio.Semaphore] = defaultdict(\n            lambda: asyncio.Semaphore(calls_per_minute)\n        )\n    \n    async def acquire(self, domain: str) -> None:\n        async with self._semaphores[domain]:\n            await asyncio.sleep(60 / 10)  # simple approach\n\nrate_limiter = RateLimiter(calls_per_minute=10)\n\nasync def polite_fetch(url: str) -> str:\n    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n    domain = urlparse(url).netloc\n    await rate_limiter.acquire(domain)\n    return await fetch_with_retry(url)\n```\n\n## Monitoring for Silent Break\n\nEvery crawler should emit shape metrics:\n\n```python\nasync def crawl_news_listing(query: str) -> list[dict]:\n    articles = await extract_articles(page)\n    \n    # Emit shape metrics\n    logger.info(\"Crawl shape\", \n        query=query,\n        article_count=len(articles),\n        with_title=sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"title\")),\n        with_url=sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"url\")),\n        with_published_at=sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"published_at\")),\n    )\n    \n    # Alert if anomalous\n    if len(articles) == 0:\n        logger.error(\"Crawler returned zero articles\", query=query)\n    \n    if sum(1 for a in articles if a.get(\"url\")) / max(len(articles), 1) < 0.5:\n        logger.warning(\"URL extraction rate dropped below 50%\", query=query)\n    \n    return articles\n```\n\n## Caching Pattern\n\n```python\nimport hashlib\nimport redis.asyncio as redis\n\nasync def fetch_cached(url: str, ttl_sec: int = 3600) -> str:\n    key = f\"crawl:{hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest()}\"\n    \n    cached = await redis_client.get(key)\n    if cached:\n        logger.debug(\"Cache hit\", url=url)\n        return cached.decode()\n    \n    content = await polite_fetch(url)\n    await redis_client.setex(key, ttl_sec, content)\n    return content\n```\n\nTTL guidance:\n- News listings: 1-6 hours\n- Article detail: 24-72 hours\n- Static content (about pages): 7 days\n- Market data: don't cache or very short TTL (5-15 min)\n\n## Storage\n\nRaw crawled pages → Cloudflare R2:\n```python\nimport boto3\n\ns3 = boto3.client(\"s3\", endpoint_url=R2_ENDPOINT)\n\ns3.put_object(\n    Bucket=\"stockforge-raw\",\n    Key=f\"raw-crawl/{domain}/{date}/{url_hash}.html\",\n    Body=content.encode(),\n    Metadata={\n        \"url\": url,\n        \"fetched_at\": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),\n        \"status_code\": str(response.status_code),\n    },\n)\n```\n\nParsed structure → Postgres. Raw preserved for reprocessing.\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Write selectors from memory (\"all CafeF pages have `.article-content`\")\n- Skip retry (\"it'll work, we tested it\")\n- Fetch in tight loops without rate limiting (get IP banned)\n- Ignore status codes (500 != 200)\n- Commit scraped data without source_url (violates I-1)\n\n**Do**:\n- Verify against live DOM\n- Retry with exponential backoff + budget cap\n- Rate limit per domain\n- Monitor shape metrics over time\n- Cache aggressively with reasonable TTL\n- Preserve raw content in R2 for reprocessing\n\n## Related\n\n- `evidence-extraction` — parsing crawled content into claims\n- `prompt-engineering` — LLM extraction from raw HTML\n- `constitution/invariants.md` — I-1 (source_url required)\n","numLines":227,"startLine":1,"totalLines":227}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"12e6de31-30fd-44a8-ac02-0e83868b6b2d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"302fc447-cdb8-4e0e-bae6-af6f07ebadcd","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}

Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n4\t---\n5\t\n6\t# Skill: FastAPI Module\n7\t\n8\t## Purpose\n9\t\n10\tConsistent FastAPI router structure across StockForge's HTTP gateway (Phase 2+).\n11\t\n12\tNote: Phase 1 uses Streamlit for the personal dashboard. FastAPI is for Phase 2+ public API or when a proper HTTP interface is needed for workers.\n13\t\n14\t## Router Template\n15\t\n16\t```python\n17\t# apps/api/<bc_name>/routers/<resource>_router.py\n18\t\n19\tfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\n20\tfrom typing import Annotated\n21\t\n22\tfrom apps.api.shared.dependencies import get_db, get_event_bus\n23\tfrom packages.application.analysis.use_cases.validate_thesis_use_case import ValidateThesisUseCase\n24\tfrom apps.api.analysis.dto.thesis_dto import CreateThesisRequest, ThesisResponse\n25\tfrom apps.api.analysis.dto.thesis_dto import ThesisMapper\n26\tfrom packages.infrastructure.analysis.persistence.thesis_postgres_repository import ThesisPostgresRepository\n27\t\n28\trouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/theses\", tags=[\"analysis\"])\n29\t\n30\t\n31\tdef get_validate_thesis_use_case(\n32\t    db: Annotated[DatabaseClient, Depends(get_db)],\n33\t    event_bus: Annotated[EventBus, Depends(get_event_bus)],\n34\t) -> ValidateThesisUseCase:\n35\t    return ValidateThesisUseCase(\n36\t        thesis_repo=ThesisPostgresRepository(db),\n37\t        event_bus=event_bus,\n38\t    )\n39\t\n40\t\n41\t@router.post(\"/\", response_model=ThesisResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)\n42\tasync def create_thesis(\n43\t    request: CreateThesisRequest,\n44\t    use_case: Annotated[ValidateThesisUseCase, Depends(get_validate_thesis_use_case)],\n45\t) -> ThesisResponse:\n46\t    result = await use_case.execute(\n47\t        ticker=request.ticker,\n48\t        bull_case_text=request.bull_case,\n49\t        bear_case_text=request.bear_case,\n50\t    )\n51\t    return ThesisMapper.to_response(result)\n52\t```\n53\t\n54\t## Naming Conventions\n55\t\n56\t| Type | Pattern | Example |\n57\t|---|---|---|\n58\t| Router | `<resource>_router.py` | `theses_router.py` |\n59\t| DTO (request) | `<Action><Resource>Request` | `CreateThesisRequest` |\n60\t| DTO (response) | `<Resource>Response` | `ThesisResponse` |\n61\t| Use case | `<Verb><Resource>UseCase` | `ValidateThesisUseCase` |\n62\t| Mapper | `<Resource>Mapper` | `ThesisMapper` |\n63\t\n64\t## DTO Pattern (Pydantic v2 — interfaces layer only)\n65\t\n66\t```python\n67\t# apps/api/analysis/dto/thesis_dto.py\n68\t\n69\tfrom pydantic import BaseModel, field_validator\n70\tfrom packages.domain.analysis.models.thesis import Thesis\n71\t\n72\tclass CreateThesisRequest(BaseModel):\n73\t    ticker: str\n74\t    bull_case: str\n75\t    bear_case: str\n76\t\n77\t    @field_validator(\"ticker\")\n78\t    @classmethod\n79\t    def validate_ticker(cls, v: str) -> str:\n80\t        return v.strip().upper()\n81\t\n82\t    @field_validator(\"bear_case\")\n83\t    @classmethod\n84\t    def bear_case_must_be_substantive(cls, v: str) -> str:\n85\t        if len(v.strip()) < 50:\n86\t            raise ValueError(\"Bear case must be substantive (>50 chars)\")\n87\t        return v\n88\t\n89\t\n90\tclass ThesisResponse(BaseModel):\n91\t    id: str\n92\t    ticker: str\n93\t    status: str\n94\t    bull_case_summary: str\n95\t    bear_case_summary: str\n96\t    created_at: str\n97\t\n98\t\n99\tclass ThesisMapper:\n100\t    @staticmethod\n101\t    def to_response(thesis: Thesis) -> ThesisResponse:\n102\t        return ThesisResponse(\n103\t            id=str(thesis.id),\n104\t            ticker=str(thesis.ticker),\n105\t            status=thesis.status.value,\n106\t            bull_case_summary=thesis.bull_case.summary,\n107\t            bear_case_summary=thesis.bear_case.summary,\n108\t            created_at=thesis.created_at.isoformat(),\n109\t        )\n110\t```\n111\t\n112\t## Port + Adapter Pattern (Domain → Infrastructure)\n113\t\n114\tPort (Protocol) in domain:\n115\t```python\n116\t# packages/domain/analysis/repositories/thesis_repository.py\n117\tfrom typing import Protocol\n118\t\n119\tclass ThesisRepository(Protocol):\n120\t    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n121\t    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n122\t```\n123\t\n124\tAdapter (implementation) in infrastructure:\n125\t```python\n126\t# packages/infrastructure/analysis/persistence/thesis_postgres_repository.py\n127\tclass ThesisPostgresRepository:\n128\t    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseClient) -> None:\n129\t        self._db = db\n130\t    \n131\t    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n132\t    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n133\t```\n134\t\n135\tWire at router dependency injection (shown above).\n136\t\n137\t## App Factory\n138\t\n139\t```python\n140\t# apps/api/main.py\n141\tfrom fastapi import FastAPI\n142\tfrom apps.api.analysis.routers.theses_router import router as theses_router\n143\tfrom apps.api.influence.routers.kols_router import router as kols_router\n144\t\n145\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n146\t    app = FastAPI(\n147\t        title=\"StockForge API\",\n148\t        description=\"AI-first investment research — Vietnamese stock market\",\n149\t        version=\"0.1.0\",\n150\t    )\n151\t    \n152\t    app.include_router(theses_router, prefix=\"/api/v1\")\n153\t    app.include_router(kols_router, prefix=\"/api/v1\")\n154\t    \n155\t    return app\n156\t\n157\tapp = create_app()\n158\t```\n159\t\n160\t## Testing Setup\n161\t\n162\t```python\n163\t# apps/api/tests/test_theses_router.py\n164\timport pytest\n165\tfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n166\tfrom unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock\n167\t\n168\tfrom apps.api.main import create_app\n169\tfrom apps.api.analysis.routers.theses_router import get_validate_thesis_use_case\n170\t\n171\t@pytest.fixture\n172\tdef mock_use_case() -> AsyncMock:\n173\t    return AsyncMock(spec=ValidateThesisUseCase)\n174\t\n175\t@pytest.fixture\n176\tdef client(mock_use_case: AsyncMock) -> TestClient:\n177\t    app = create_app()\n178\t    app.dependency_overrides[get_validate_thesis_use_case] = lambda: mock_use_case\n179\t    return TestClient(app)\n180\t\n181\tdef test_create_thesis_dispatches_to_use_case(\n182\t    client: TestClient,\n183\t    mock_use_case: AsyncMock,\n184\t) -> None:\n185\t    mock_use_case.execute.return_value = make_thesis_fixture()\n186\t    \n187\t    response = client.post(\"/api/v1/theses/\", json={\n188\t        \"ticker\": \"VCB\",\n189\t        \"bull_case\": \"Strong earnings growth driven by retail expansion...\",\n190\t        \"bear_case\": \"Rising NPL ratio may compress margins and trigger provision surge...\",\n191\t    })\n192\t    \n193\t    assert response.status_code == 201\n194\t    mock_use_case.execute.assert_called_once()\n195\t```\n196\t\n197\t## Router Boundary Rules\n198\t\n199\t- **Never import** another BC's router module directly\n200\t- **Never import** from `packages/domain/<otherBc>/` in this router\n201\t- Cross-BC integration via:\n202\t  - Domain events (published, subscribed via contracts)\n203\t  - HTTP calls fastapi-module\ndescription: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n---\n\n# Skill: FastAPI Module\n\n## Purpose\n\nConsistent FastAPI router structure across StockForge's HTTP gateway (Phase 2+).\n\nNote: Phase 1 uses Streamlit for the personal dashboard. FastAPI is for Phase 2+ public API or when a proper HTTP interface is needed for workers.\n\n## Router Template\n\n```python\n# apps/api/<bc_name>/routers/<resource>_router.py\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom apps.api.shared.dependencies import get_db, get_event_bus\nfrom packages.application.analysis.use_cases.validate_thesis_use_case import ValidateThesisUseCase\nfrom apps.api.analysis.dto.thesis_dto import CreateThesisRequest, ThesisResponse\nfrom apps.api.analysis.dto.thesis_dto import ThesisMapper\nfrom packages.infrastructure.analysis.persistence.thesis_postgres_repository import ThesisPostgresRepository\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/theses\", tags=[\"analysis\"])\n\n\ndef get_validate_thesis_use_case(\n    db: Annotated[DatabaseClient, Depends(get_db)],\n    event_bus: Annotated[EventBus, Depends(get_event_bus)],\n) -> ValidateThesisUseCase:\n    return ValidateThesisUseCase(\n        thesis_repo=ThesisPostgresRepository(db),\n        event_bus=event_bus,\n    )\n\n\n@router.post(\"/\", response_model=ThesisResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)\nasync def create_thesis(\n    request: CreateThesisRequest,\n    use_case: Annotated[ValidateThesisUseCase, Depends(get_validate_thesis_use_case)],\n) -> ThesisResponse:\n    result = await use_case.execute(\n        ticker=request.ticker,\n        bull_case_text=request.bull_case,\n        bear_case_text=request.bear_case,\n    )\n    return ThesisMapper.to_response(result)\n```\n\n## Naming Conventions\n\n| Type | Pattern | Example |\n|---|---|---|\n| Router | `<resource>_router.py` | `theses_router.py` |\n| DTO (request) | `<Action><Resource>Request` | `CreateThesisRequest` |\n| DTO (response) | `<Resource>Response` | `ThesisResponse` |\n| Use case | `<Verb><Resource>UseCase` | `ValidateThesisUseCase` |\n| Mapper | `<Resource>Mapper` | `ThesisMapper` |\n\n## DTO Pattern (Pydantic v2 — interfaces layer only)\n\n```python\n# apps/api/analysis/dto/thesis_dto.py\n\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, field_validator\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.models.thesis import Thesis\n\nclass CreateThesisRequest(BaseModel):\n    ticker: str\n    bull_case: str\n    bear_case: str\n\n    @field_validator(\"ticker\")\n    @classmethod\n    def validate_ticker(cls, v: str) -> str:\n        return v.strip().upper()\n\n    @field_validator(\"bear_case\")\n    @classmethod\n    def bear_case_must_be_substantive(cls, v: str) -> str:\n        if len(v.strip()) < 50:\n            raise ValueError(\"Bear case must be substantive (>50 chars)\")\n        return v\n\n\nclass ThesisResponse(BaseModel):\n    id: str\n    ticker: str\n    status: str\n    bull_case_summary: str\n    bear_case_summary: str\n    created_at: str\n\n\nclass ThesisMapper:\n    @staticmethod\n    def to_response(thesis: Thesis) -> ThesisResponse:\n        return ThesisResponse(\n            id=str(thesis.id),\n            ticker=str(thesis.ticker),\n            status=thesis.status.value,\n            bull_case_summary=thesis.bull_case.summary,\n            bear_case_summary=thesis.bear_case.summary,\n            created_at=thesis.created_at.isoformat(),\n        )\n```\n\n## Port + Adapter Pattern (Domain → Infrastructure)\n\nPort (Protocol) in domain:\n```python\n# packages/domain/analysis/repositories/thesis_repository.py\nfrom typing import Protocol\n\nclass ThesisRepository(Protocol):\n    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n```\n\nAdapter (implementation) in infrastructure:\n```python\n# packages/infrastructure/analysis/persistence/thesis_postgres_repository.py\nclass ThesisPostgresRepository:\n    def __init__(self, db: DatabaseClient) -> None:\n        self._db = db\n    \n    async def save(self, thesis: Thesis) -> None: ...\n    async def find_by_id(self, id: ThesisId) -> Thesis | None: ...\n```\n\nWire at router dependency injection (shown above).\n\n## App Factory\n\n```python\n# apps/api/main.py\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI\nfrom apps.api.analysis.routers.theses_router import router as theses_router\nfrom apps.api.influence.routers.kols_router import router as kols_router\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(\n        title=\"StockForge API\",\n        description=\"AI-first investment research — Vietnamese stock market\",\n        version=\"0.1.0\",\n    )\n    \n    app.include_router(theses_router, prefix=\"/api/v1\")\n    app.include_router(kols_router, prefix=\"/api/v1\")\n    \n    return app\n\napp = create_app()\n```\n\n## Testing Setup\n\n```python\n# apps/api/tests/test_theses_router.py\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock\n\nfrom apps.api.main import create_app\nfrom apps.api.analysis.routers.theses_router import get_validate_thesis_use_case\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef mock_use_case() -> AsyncMock:\n    return AsyncMock(spec=ValidateThesisUseCase)\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client(mock_use_case: AsyncMock) -> TestClient:\n    app = create_app()\n    app.dependency_overrides[get_validate_thesis_use_case] = lambda: mock_use_case\n    return TestClient(app)\n\ndef test_create_thesis_dispatches_to_use_case(\n    client: TestClient,\n    mock_use_case: AsyncMock,\n) -> None:\n    mock_use_case.execute.return_value = make_thesis_fixture()\n    \n    response = client.post(\"/api/v1/theses/\", json={\n        \"ticker\": \"VCB\",\n        \"bull_case\": \"Strong earnings growth driven by retail expansion...\",\n        \"bear_case\": \"Rising NPL ratio may compress margins and trigger provision surge...\",\n    })\n    \n    assert response.status_code == 201\n    mock_use_case.execute.assert_called_once()\n```\n\n## Router Boundary Rules\n\n- **Never import** another BC's router module directly\n- **Never import** from `packages/domain/<otherBc>/` in this router\n- Cross-BC integration via:\n  - Domain events (published, subscribed via contracts)\n  - HTTP calls if service boundary strictly required\n  - Shared kernel (contracts package)\n\n## Anti-Patterns\n\n**Don't**:\n- Put business logic in routers (use cases own it)\n- Import repositories directly in routers (use case mediates)\n- Use Pydantic models in domain layer (domain uses dataclasses)\n- Mix use cases from multiple BCs in one router\n- Skip the port/Protocol indirection for \"simple\" repos\n\n**Do**:\n- One router per bounded context resource\n- Thin routers, thick use cases\n- Protocol/adapter everywhere for testability\n- Pydantic DTOs at HTTP boundary only\n- Validate inputs at DTO level\n\n## Related\n\n- `ddd-tactical-patterns` — for domain models this router uses\n- `postgres-pgvector` — for repository implementations\n","numLines":226,"startLine":1,"totalLines":226}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d6cebaee-3728-4c83-9796-7a5edf649572","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"302fc447-cdb8-4e0e-bae6-af6f07ebadcd","version":"2.1.122","gitBranch":"main"}
